project: Wuxia Life P25 Main Screen Single-Step Progression and Modal Interaction
description: Tighten the main screen loop so one primary action advances directly to the next interactive phase while preserving result visibility in overlays. Also move active choices into the top event card and replace scroll-driven secondary interactions with modal or drawer patterns.

userStories.title: Advance To Next Interactive Phase In One Primary Action
userStories.description: As a player, I want one primary action to both preserve the result and move me to the next interactive phase so that the loop no longer requires two separate continue clicks.
acceptanceCriteria: Story choice resolution no longer requires a second continue click
Active action resolution no longer requires a second continue click
Passive progression no longer requires a second continue click
Current-step result remains visible after the automatic advance

userStories.title: Unify Active And Story Choices In The Top Event Card
userStories.description: As a player, I want active-planning choices and story choices to appear in the same top interaction area so that I do not have to scroll to find the main loop buttons.
acceptanceCriteria: Active choices render inside the top event card
Story choices render inside the top event card
The lower page area no longer serves as the primary choice region

userStories.title: Replace Scroll-Based Secondary Access With Modal Interactions
userStories.description: As a player, I want life summary and full stats to open in overlays rather than via scroll-based jumps so that the main screen stays single-screen friendly.
acceptanceCriteria: Life summary opens in a modal or drawer
Full stats open in a modal or drawer
Main screen no longer uses scrollIntoView for these secondary interactions

userStories.title: Keep API And Local Main-Screen Progression Behaviors Consistent
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want API mode and local mode to follow the same single-step progression behavior so that testing and player experience do not diverge.
acceptanceCriteria: API mode no longer presents a blocking double-continue loop
Local mode no longer presents a blocking double-continue loop
Result preservation and top-card interaction layout are consistent across both modes
